description: Two-tick stall scenario like 30-escalate-stall-timeout, but the caller passes --stall-timeout 0 to disable the escalation. Tick 2 sees the same fingerprint at a far-past firstSeenAt (same as 30), but applyStallGuard treats stallTimeoutSeconds <= 0 as 'disabled: refresh and never escalate' — it stays wait instead of escalating.
